  "pros": [
    "Robust features for managing complex creative workflows and approvals.",
    "Centralized platform for project timelines, resourcing, and asset tracking.",
    "Scalability to support a growing mid-to-large company's operational needs."
  ],
  "cons": [
    "Steeper learning curve and initial setup compared to simpler tools like Trello.",
    "Occasional complexity in navigating advanced features or customizing dashboards.",
    "Customer support response times could sometimes be improved."
  ],
  "overall_experience": "This Manager of Creative Operations has found Wrike to be a highly effective and robust solution for managing project timelines, resourcing, and review workflows within their Food & Beverages company. Having used it for over two years, they appreciate its comprehensive functionality and scalability, which significantly improved upon their previous Trello experience. While acknowledging a slight learning curve and occasional interface complexity, the benefits for managing creative operations in a larger organization have proven to be substantial."
